note: Base rate b is fixed at intake from this table by event class and the asset's stage on the statement date. If the item's window (statement date to deadline) is shorter than the class median time to decision, b is halved: P(E in window) = P(E | stage) x P(T <= window | E) <= 0.5 x P(E | stage) when the window is below the median, so halving is an upper bound that favours the forecaster. If no class fits, the item has no b and the reference row abstains on it; 0.5 is never substituted. External studies only; the ledger never derives a base rate from its own items.
